messages:
anya: FYI multiple customers hitting 502/504s on hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC. Symptoms: request latency spikes then downstream 5xx. Example log: 
```
[09:13:02] request_id=rc_01F3KV upstream=cache-prefix fetch timeout err=memcached: connection timeout (i/o timeout) route=hosted-inference model=gpt-4-azure
[09:13:03] request_id=rc_01F3KV proxy=api-gateway status=502 msg=upstream_failed
```
Customer repro attached (short curl) below.

matt: Ack. Any request IDs + customer org? Can you paste the curl? :eyes:

anya: request_id=rc_01F3KV org=acme-inc. Repro (redacted token):
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-redwood","input":"hello"}'
```
Response is immediate 502 with body `{ "error": "upstream fetch failed" }`.

sre-oncall: I see matching alerts — memcached prefix cluster in us-east-1 showing connection churn and >200ms p95 get latency starting 09:10 UTC. Other infra graphs: increased client-side reconnects and socket timeouts. Suspecting KV prefix prefetch fanout during cold cache events. ops-bot, can you dump the latest alert? :mag:

ops-bot: ALERT: memcached-pfx-us-east degraded — node-flapping detected (4/6) | p95_get_latency=240ms | conn_errors=12/min | triggered 09:11 UTC

kevin: If prefix fetches are fanouting, a single heavy request that triggers a wide prefetch can blow up memcached. Short-term mitigation: reduce prefetch fanout and enable fallback-to-miss for hosted tier for affected models. We can toggle runtime flag `enable_prefix_prefetch` -> false for the next hour. That should stop the thundering fanout.

matt: How to toggle it? Need exact admin API call so support can offer mitigation to customers.

kevin: Admin API command (ops only):
```
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"enable_prefix_prefetch","value":false,"scope":"hosted"}'
```
Also recommend setting `cache_fallback_policy=allow-miss` in routing rules for hosted inference while we stabilize.

support-jen: I'll send a short customer-safe banner: "We're investigating intermittent 502s affecting model inference in us-east-1; temporary mitigation available — we can route traffic to bypass prefix-cache on request. ETA for mitigation ~10-15m." Want me to send to impacted orgs now?

anya: Please do. I'm going to try the toggle in staging first and then ops can apply prod. Staging toggle stopped the 502s in our replay test — latency back to baseline and no memcached timeouts.

sre-oncall: Confirmed — after disabling prefetch in staging, p95_get_latency dropped from 240ms -> 18ms, no further conn errors in the window. Rolling prod mitigation now.

ops-bot: ACTION: Flag update queued by kevin -> apply to hosted in us-east-1. Job 3182 started at 09:31 UTC.

matt: After prod toggle started 09:34, customer telemetry shows 502s drop ~90% and latency improving. Keep an eye for any regressions. Can we also capture the traces for requests that produced high fanout? Need to root cause why prefetch ramped up.

kevin: Short RCA hypothesis: recent runtime change (heuristic that expanded prefix fanout on cold misses to improve P99 quality) accidentally increased fanout multiplier under certain multi-tenant workloads. Repro steps for devs: run 200 concurrent cold-prefix requests with distinct keys and observe memcached get spikes. I'll open a GH issue with failing trace samples.

anya: Customer update sent and acknowledged. They asked for a timeline; I gave the mitigation ETA and that we rolled a temporary flag. They also requested logs for request_id=rc_01F3KV which I attached.

sre-oncall: Action items: 
- kevin to open GH issue + revert heuristic patch or limit multiplier (P0) 
- infra to run memcached rolling restart window to clear flappy nodes (low risk) 
- product to consider safe guard: throttle prefetch fanout per-org
- support to follow up with impacted customers and offer log bundle

kevin: Opened GH issue: redwood/runtime#4521 with sample traces and a repro script. Assigning to runtime team and tagging infra for memcached health check. :white_check_mark:

support-jen: I'll follow up with the impacted customers in 30m with final mitigation note and next steps. Template ready.

anya: Thanks everyone — keeping thread open until postmortem. Adding trace snippet here for ops if needed:
```
TRACE rc_01F3KV: prefetch_keys=512 fanout=8 -> mem_get_batch(keys=512) -> 502 upstream_timeout
```
